# Feature: Peep hole — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #60 (Peep hole) from Vision and Information before it is used in real levels. Effect: see the next room through a gap. Unique: vision into the next room with no way through. Useful: preview a lock or enemy before committing to enter. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** see the next room through a gap.

**So that** preview a lock or enemy before committing to enter.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Peep hole for the first time in its teaching room (mech-60-peep-hole-room). Teaching moment: First room: a peep hole before a one-way door, showing a lock in the room beyond. A player who peeps, sees only part of the room, and commits through the one-way door discovers the enemy the pan did not reach and is returned to the checkpoint, which teaches that a preview is partial and that the timer kept running while it was shown. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Stepping on it locks your controls and pans the camera up for two seconds into the next room, which is otherwise drawn black until you enter it in person
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Then the camera returns and you choose whether to go in

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Peep hole's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-60-peep-hole-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/vision-and-information.yml mechanic #60.

- [ ] Rule verified in mech-60-peep-hole-room: Then the camera returns and you choose whether to go in

- Synergies deferred to a later run (do not build now): Locked rooms (one-way door 4): preview the lock you are about to commit to.
- Demos deferred (reference only): Fog-of-war scrolling: rooms stay unrevealed until visited, peeping is the one exception.
- Confirm any new sprite/tile def and any HUD counter this mechanic needs before the implement task is approved.

Record play sessions for replay: yes — sessions are the review evidence. Synergy rooms are explicitly deferred to a later run and are not part of this feature's check.
